capabilities: Open .yaml, .yml, and optionally .json AsyncAPI spec files in a rendered view
Toggle between rendered preview and a source editor
Embed specs in notes via code blocks or vault file references
Open spec files via deep links and a file explorer context menu
extras: If another plugin such as OpenAPI Renderer already owns a file extension, the plugin skips that extension with a notice; embeds, context menu and deep links still work. A deep link trigger requires the user to trust the asyncapi-open action on first outside use. Release process (semantic-release) is described in the README but is contributor-facing, not user-facing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or render AsyncAPI event-driven API specification files stored in the vault.
summary: Renders AsyncAPI 2.x and 3.x specification files in a preview view with a source editor, embeds, deep links, and file-type ownership settings.
